item.title: [ECG] ACRA Build-Your-Own-Business (BYOB) Accounting Gameboard Challenge
item.description: ACRA (Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority) invites students to take part in the Accounting Gameboard Challenge 2026 – designed to spark students’ interest in the accountancy profession through experiential learning. This challenge features the Build-Your-Own-Business (BYOB) Accounting Gameboard , developed by Republic Polytechnic. It introduces students to fundamental financial and management accounting concepts, demonstrating how these principles support real-world decision-making and entrepreneurship. Why it's Worth Your Time: Students get hands-on exposure to accounting concepts through gameplay, making it a strong addition to their portfolio. For students exploring business or accountancy pathways, it’s also a great way to stand out. Get to win attractive prizes! If you are interested in the accountancy profession and would like to form a team to participate, please fill in this form . Some things to note: No prior accounting knowledge is required! This competition is open to all Sec 3, Sec 4, C1 and C2 students. You will need to form a team of 3 students . Ms Mary Ann from the ECG Unit will get in touch with you if you are nominated to participate in this competition. Please sign up by 10 July (Fri), 5pm . Thank you! Key Details: Date: 24 July 202 Venue: Republic Polytechnic Time: 1.30pm - 5.30pm Important Things to Note: You will be required to arrange your own transport to the competition. Do ensure you have sufficient travel time to make it to the competition. You will not be granted any LOA to attend this competition.
